description: Official classification values for bank CDM adoption posture

ARCHITECT.description: Banks actively building, contributing to, or implementing CDM

Leader.description: Production or pilot with significant contribution

PRAGMATIST.description: Banks waiting for external pressure, utilities, or vendor solutions

Vendor-Dependent.description: Will adopt CDM through third-party vendor tools

Integration-Constrained.description: Capacity consumed by other priorities (mergers, legacy migration)

Regulatory-Driven.description: Will move only when mandated by regulators

Network-Accelerant.description: Will move based on counterparty or peer pressure

OBSERVER.description: Banks aware of CDM but with minimal direct engagement

Active-Watcher.description: Monitoring CDM developments, attending events, but not contributing

UNKNOWN.description: Insufficient or conflicting evidence to classify

Insufficient-Evidence.description: Not enough evidence found to make determination

NOT_ENGAGED.rationale: All banks are 'engaged' to some degree; PRAGMATIST better captures wait-and-see posture

NON-ARCHITECT.suggested_variant: Based on evidence of why not ARCHITECT
NON-ARCHITECT.rationale: Negative framing replaced with descriptive posture

CDM User (via vendors).rationale: Clarifies bank is not building internally

Potential Future Adopter.rationale: All PRAGMATIST banks are potential future adopters; specify the trigger

validation_rules: classification must be one of valid_classifications
sub_classification must match a variant for the chosen classification
deprecated terms should be replaced in new analyses
existing status.json files using deprecated terms should be updated
usage_notes: Use this taxonomy when creating status.json files
Reference in agent prompts via config/classification-taxonomy.json
Update checkpoint-log.json entries to use standard taxonomy
